checkpoints.hint: Reshape the grid and toggle wrap-around. Flip wrap on and watch the diameter (worst-case hops, the amber path) roughly halve — a ring gives every node a second way around. Square up the grid (e.g. 4x16 → 8x8) and watch the bisection (the red cut, the links you'd sever to split it in half) rise. Same node count, faster network — that's why cluster shape and job placement set the speed limit on the all-reduce.
